title: Supply of Furniture items for the staff quarters of Manappad Point Lighthouse station under Chennai directorate
summary: Notice inviting sealed quotations for supply of teak wood single cots and teak wood dining table sets for the staff quarters of Manappad Point Lighthouse, Tuticorin district, Tamil Nadu.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Manappad Point Lighthouse, Manappad Post, Tiruchendur Taluk, Tuticorin, Tamilnadu-628209
sites.work: Supply of furniture for staff quarters

scope.item: Supply of Teak Wood Single Cot, size 6¼' x 3', centre bedding portion plywood, inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight up to Manappad Point Lighthouse
Supply of teakwood dining table size 5' x 3' with 4 chairs, inclusive of loading, unloading, packing, forwarding, freight up to Manappad Point Lighthouse

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value as PBG/FDR, valid 60 days beyond warranty period and all contractual obligations; released after 1-year warranty
money.notes: Rates inclusive of all taxes. Payment on final account basis after satisfactory supply; no extra payment beyond quoted rate.

period.completion: 10 days from date of supply order
period.warranty: 1 year against manufacturing defects for all wooden items

eligibility: Similar work in last seven years ending 31 March 2025: one work >= Rs 1,96,800, or two each >= Rs 1,23,000, or three each >= Rs 98,400
Similar work: supply of office furniture items in Central Govt/State Govt/public listed/PSUs; proof by completion certificates with PO/GeM CRAC
Non-blacklisting affidavit on firm letterhead for last 3 years
Valid registration and office address in Tamil Nadu/Puducherry (MSME certificate, business registration)
Detailed technical specifications of items as per Annexure A
specs: Teak wood single cot 6.25' x 3' (photo shows with mattress), plywood centre bedding
Teak wood dining table 5' x 3' with 4 chairs
Design as per photo images attached; material (wood) inspection before polishing/varnishing
notes: Scanned NIQ with Annexure A (schedule of work), Annexure B (terms) and two reference photos. No estimated cost or EMD printed. Photo caption for cot says 'with Mattress' though schedule does not list a mattress. Station spelled Manappad; station list has Manapad Point.
